title: The Roots of the Smile
subtitle: Sami & Mina are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🦷💪

Sami is an impatient dentist: 'An implant? It's simple, I place it in 20 minutes!' Mina, an implantology expert, corrects him: 'Not so fast, Sami! Implantology is much more than just screwing in an implant.'

Between bone atrophy, sinus lift, peri-implantitis, or implant fracture, placing implants is a true art.

Insufficient planning, a poor implant choice, and the patient loses their implant. Surgical rigor, good osseointegration, and the patient regains their smile and function.

The stability of implants, patients' oral health, and the longevity of restorations rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant2: Sami and Mina delve into advanced techniques: sinus lift, bone grafts, short implants, immediate loading. They discover that every case is unique.
chapters.intermediaire1: Sami and Mina master planning: CBCT, surgical guides, implant selection, osseointegration. They learn to evaluate each patient precisely.
chapters.intermediaire2: Sami and Mina tackle advanced techniques: sinus lift, bone grafts, short implants, immediate loading. Implantology is put to the test.

chapters.expert2: After years of practice, Sami and Mina leave a legacy of implantology skills. Implantology is the art of rebuilding the smile.
